content: Vercel Hobby plan serverless functions: default execution limit is 10 seconds (killed with 504 past that); Fluid Compute can extend to up to 300s on Hobby if enabled; Pro raises defaults to 60s/up to 300s. Long-running bulk import processing (validating/inserting hundreds-thousands of rows) risks hitting this ceiling on a single request/response cycle; needs chunked/background processing rather than one synchronous handler call.
